protocol.purpose: representation-frozen full-fold screen of supervision and gradient-estimator effects before expensive end-to-end LoRA
protocol.test_lock: all 48 heads and validation artifacts must be complete and checksummed before any test file is parsed

requirements: treatment has lower held-out soft CE in at least 9 of 12 paired endpoints
mean held-out soft CE delta is below zero
no workflow's three-seed mean held-out soft CE regresses by more than 0.01
mean seen-workflow soft CE does not regress by more than 0.005
mean held-out soft Brier does not regress
advancement.boundary: passing advances an objective to end-to-end LoRA validation only; this frozen-representation screen cannot establish final model quality
